correctness.rationale: Derive equality of elementary sums and constant cubic difference h. Parity excludes odd h and shared factor two, so all normalized prime offsets are even. The minimum of the six primes lies on the smaller-product side. Exhausting a<b<c even with abc<320 yields exactly 37 candidate offset triples and precisely two nonzero square-discriminant shapes. Each has a modulo-three obstruction; the six prime factors for h=320 have directly checked phi/sigma jumps exactly 320. The verifier reproduces all 37 cases with exact arithmetic; it does not alone prove the normalization.

value.rationale: The minimal positive common jump for squarefree three-prime argument pairs is a sharply defined, motivated invariant arising from the newly studied simultaneous phi/sigma equation. The theorem gives its exact value 320, an explicit six-prime extremizer, and a structural proof of the infinite argument range by a 37-case arithmetic sieve. This determines a genuine minimality boundary rather than an arbitrary computation or a mere restatement of an old PTE identity.
